start: Menu: Messages & offers (address /messages), gym online, some members have the app

steps.action: Open Messages & offers
user_sees: Title "Messages & offers", under it "Messages, offers and wishes for your members, in the app and on WhatsApp"; tabs "Messages", "Workout offer", "Reminders"
must_not: The page shown to a front-desk login

steps.action: Pick a "Kind of message", fill "Title" and "Message", choose the "Group"
user_sees: The words as members will get them; how many of the group have the app
must_not: A count of people that includes members of another gym or archived members

steps.action: Tap "Send in the app"
user_sees: A question first, for example "Goes to {n} members in the app. Send now?" with "Yes, send" and "Not yet"
must_not: The message going out on the first tap with no question

steps.action: Tap "Yes, send"
user_sees: Button reads "Sending…", then the notice "Sent to {n} members in the app." and the pill "Sent in the app"
must_not: The message sent twice; "Sent" shown when the server refused it

steps.action: Scroll to the sent list
user_sees: The message on top with how many members have seen it and the button "Take back"
must_not: A sent message missing from the list after a reload

start: Messages & offers, part "On WhatsApp" (the one-by-one queue from the owner's own phone)

steps.action: With a message written, look under "On WhatsApp"
user_sees: Button "WhatsApp one by one ({n})" and "Opens your own WhatsApp with the words typed in. It costs nothing."; with some in the app, the choice "Not in the app" or "Whole group"
must_not: A count that includes people with no mobile number

steps.action: Tap "WhatsApp one by one ({n})"
user_sees: Sheet "WhatsApp one by one": one member at a time with the words typed; notes like "{n} without a full mobile number left out" and "{n} sharing a number with someone above, sent once"
must_not: A message sent by itself: every send is the owner's own tap in WhatsApp

steps.action: Send the first, come back, go on; tap "Skip" for one; tap "Done"
user_sees: Back on the page: "{x} of {n} done on WhatsApp for this message."
must_not: The same person offered twice; the done marks lost after closing the sheet

start: A member's page, button "WhatsApp" (one personal message)

steps.action: Open a member, tap "WhatsApp"
user_sees: Sheet "WhatsApp {member name}" with "Which message" (only the kinds that fit this member, such as fees, plan ending, birthday) and the box "Message (you can change it)"
must_not: "Happy birthday" offered on a day that is not their birthday; "Haven't seen you" for a member who came yesterday

steps.action: Change the words, tap the button that opens WhatsApp
user_sees: WhatsApp opens on this member's chat with the words typed in
must_not: WhatsApp opening on another member's number; the amount or date in the words differing from the member page

start: Messages & offers, tab "Reminders" (address /messages/reminders): the automatic reminders and the birthday wish

steps.action: Tap "Reminders"
user_sees: Each automatic reminder with its switch and its number of days; with the gym not online: "Automatic reminders need your gym online"
must_not: Switches that look on while nothing is sent

steps.action: Turn the birthday wish on, change a number of days, tap the save button
user_sees: The new choices kept after a reload
must_not: A reminder sent to a member twice in one day; a wish sent for a wrong date of birth

steps.action: Leave "Title" empty
user_sees: "Send in the app" cannot be tapped and the page says what is missing
must_not: An empty message sent

steps.action: Write a message when no member has the app yet, tap "Send in the app"
user_sees: "No member has the app yet. Members who join in the next 14 days will see it. Send now?"
must_not: "Sent to 0 members" with no warning before

steps.action: Pick a group in which nobody has the app
user_sees: "Send in the app" cannot be tapped; "WhatsApp one by one" still offers them
must_not: The message quietly going to every member instead of the group

steps.action: Pick "When" later and type a day and time in the past
user_sees: The send button cannot be tapped until the time is a real future time
must_not: A message timed in the past sent at once without saying so

steps.action: Tap "Not yet" at the question
user_sees: The question goes away; nothing sent; the words stay typed
must_not: The typed words cleared

steps.action: Send a message now, then tap "Take back" on it
user_sees: Browser question "Take back “{title}”? It is removed from every member’s inbox."; after OK the row fades and shows the pill "Taken back"
must_not: The message still in members' inboxes after "Taken back" shows

steps.action: Send a message timed for tomorrow
user_sees: Notice "Goes out {when} to {n} members in the app."; the row shows "Goes out {when} · {n} members" and the button "Cancel"
must_not: A timed message going out at once

steps.action: Tap "Cancel" on the timed message and confirm
user_sees: The pill "Cancelled"; it never goes out
must_not: The cancelled message going out at its time

steps.action: Change one word of a message already sent
user_sees: The pill "Sent in the app" goes and "Send in the app" is back, as this is a new message
must_not: The changed words blocked as already sent, or the old one sent again unchanged

start: Messages & offers: who gets a message and who can read it

steps.action: Pick a group, where the in-app send cannot be narrowed to it
user_sees: The question says so in words: "Goes to all {n} members in the app, not only this group. Send now?"
must_not: A fees reminder reaching members who owe nothing without the owner being told

steps.action: Send, then open the member app as a member of this gym
user_sees: The message in the member's inbox; a member sees only messages of their own gym
must_not: A member of another gym, or a removed member, getting it

steps.action: Use WhatsApp one by one for a personal kind (fees due)
user_sees: Each member's own name, amount and dates; one chat per member
must_not: One member's dues or dates typed into another member's chat; a group chat showing everyone's numbers

start: Members, a filter that has a ready message (fees due, expired, plan ending, birthday), signed in as front desk

steps.action: Open Members and tap the filter for fees due
user_sees: The members who owe, and the button "WhatsApp all {n}, one by one"
must_not: The button shown on a filter with no ready message, or with n = 0

steps.action: Tap "WhatsApp all {n}, one by one"
user_sees: Sheet "WhatsApp one by one" with the first member and the words typed for them
must_not: A total of the gym's dues shown to the desk

steps.action: Open WhatsApp for this member, send, come back
user_sees: The next member not yet done
must_not: The same member again; a member with no mobile number in the queue

steps.action: Tap "Skip" on one, "Back" once, then "Done"
user_sees: The sheet closes; opening it again starts at the first one not sent, with "Go to the first one not sent" and "Start the list again"
must_not: Done marks lost on reopening; a skipped member marked as sent

start: Address /messages/reminders or /messages/offer (the two message pages open to the desk)

steps.action: Open /messages/reminders
user_sees: Title "Automatic reminders", under it "What members get on their phone by themselves"; tabs "Workout offer" and "Reminders" only; "Only the owner can change these."
must_not: The tab "Messages"; a switch the desk can change

steps.action: Tap "Workout offer"
user_sees: Title "Workout offer", under it "Rewards for members who train"
must_not: Buttons to start, stop or take back an offer

start: A typed or old address: /messages, and the old /shop/messages

steps.action: Type the address /messages
user_sees: "Only an owner can see this" with "Ask your gym owner if you need something from here." and the button "Back to Today"
must_not: The message writer shown to the desk, even for a moment

steps.action: Open an old link /shop/messages
user_sees: The Shop page instead
must_not: A blank page

steps.action: Tap "Back to Today"
user_sees: Today
must_not: A loop back to the blocked page

steps.action: Send to 3 of 10 members, tap "Done", open the same filter's queue again
user_sees: The queue opens on the 4th; 3 are remembered as done on this browser
must_not: All 10 offered again from the start

steps.action: Tap "Start the list again"
user_sees: The queue is back at the first member with no done marks
must_not: Old done marks hiding people after a restart

steps.action: A member pays in between; open the queue again
user_sees: The paid member is no longer in the fees-due list
must_not: A fees reminder typed for someone who has paid

start: What the desk may send and see

steps.action: Look for any way to send an in-app message to all members
user_sees: None: sending messages is the owner's; the server refuses a desk login too
must_not: A desk login sending a message to every member's phone

steps.action: Use the queue for fees due
user_sees: Each member's own amount only, in their own chat
must_not: Totals of all fees due shown to the desk; one member's amount in another's chat
